title: PSG-LB2-BANK: linear classical memory for the published quasipolynomial-copy log-log-band sieve

claims.statement: For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the ONE physical PSG-LB2-BANK interpreter in proof.md executing the COMPLETE selected P=PSG-LB2 in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret from independent ideal copies with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. On EVERY branch fully charged sequential work is O(2^(n/(2log2n)-4n/(log2n)^2)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1. The n=1 case is finite; the display describes n>=2. Every source/collective-extraction, actual integer log-log-band search, streamed verified-pair combiner, signed-label update, partial/zero-width shortcut, failed child, all-modulus decoder and BOTH source/weighted-attempt guards of P is preserved. All bank bit/address work, source SWAP, initialization, failed work and cleanup counts separately. The proved internal virtual estimate O(n^3(logn)^3 2^R) and explicit gap E-R>=n/(8(log2n)^2) absorb EVERY fixed polynomial bank/compiler overhead into the exact negative-correction envelope. All five claims concern this same physical implementation.

For the same physical PSG-LB2-BANK algorithm and every N,s on EVERY branch, peak allocated classical workspace is O(n) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. The counted controller retains N, output, a fixed number of O(n)-bit staged operands, short address/scan fields and finite code. Every other virtual label, array, frame, return context, loop/cap counter, arithmetic field, generator descriptor and allocator record is stored in the counted basis-qubit bank, with no duplicate classical stack or growing measurement transcript. Input/output coexist and are included. proof.md Sections2-6 establish the complete physical implementation, jointly with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical PSG-LB2-BANK algorithm and every N,s on EVERY branch, peak allocated quantum workspace is O(n^2) qubits, with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Seven fixed packed virtual-classical regions of C*2^(2ceil(log2(n+2))) bits each, C=2^48, and fixed linear virtual-quantum pools bound maximum address spans independently of retry count. Virtual classical bit i is physical basis wire2i, virtual quantum q is wire2(q+1)+1, and the entire doubling paired prefix including unused padding is counted. All bank values, metadata, original coherent registers, fair-bit and temporary source scratch, allocation growth, failed work and cleanup are included. No per-bit keys/flags, coherent bank address or free QRAM is introduced. This is joint with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For the SAME physical PSG-LB2-BANK interpreter, every N,s and EVERY branch, total acquired DCP copies are O(2^((log2n)^2)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. This is a QUASIPOLYNOMIAL guarantee, not a polynomial source bound. The exact CQ simulation performs one physical acquisition per virtual acquisition and no others, preserving all rejects, discards, failed attempts and cutoff aborts. P has actual q0=(2u+1)2^(R-u),H0=Sodd*K+2n,Qcap=1024(6q0H0+2n). Its reproduced virtual9 coefficient certificate log2Qcap<=L^2-(log2L-2)^2+O(1)<=L^2+O(1),L=log2n, proves the exact source envelope. Finite lengths change only outside constants. Fresh bank/padding zeros count work/storage, not source copies. Full-secret success and all other resource claims hold jointly.

For this same physical PSG-LB2-BANK algorithm/configuration, the guaranteed malformed-source fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. For every N>=2 and every secret, all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states and full-secret recovery succeeds with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 jointly with all four physical resource bounds. The bank simulation preserves the complete output and source law under this promise. Additional bank measurements may expose classical record bits under a different adaptive supplier model, for which no transfer or positive tolerance is claimed. Zero is not an impossibility assertion about greater robustness.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
